title: Deeper/broader cross-codec DWG failure-chain and whole-file acceptance audit
mode: Primary-source review of peer issue histories and current local implementation/test owners
scope: Reconcile LibreDWG AC1021 decode and owner-iteration reports with their subsequent fix status.
Refresh ACadSharp MTEXT whole-file and SPLINE reports against local read-only and semantic evidence boundaries.
Confirm existing local robustness/EED tests cover the adversarial shapes from current peer reports.
Refine implementation-ready gates without adding fixtures, peer prerequisites, or per-slice test cost.

local_source_files_inspected: tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: repeated DXF record robustness and XDATA boundaries
tests/block_owner_tests.cpp: PAR-49/7G.3 composite BLOCK/INSERT ownership control
local_checks: Verified the LibreDWG #1361 report is closed and #1363 merged; the reporter corrected the original LWPOLYLINE-array hypothesis to Reed-Solomon decoding of uncompressed AC1021 pages.

Verified #1357's reporter later measured restored counts on named LibreDWG master commit 56a05f98 and identified the contemporaneous AC1021 decoder change as the likely cause; the separate defensive #1359 pull request remains open in the reviewed page state.
Compared the local AC1021 generated page transform matrix with the peer profile and retained the existing unresolved tablet CRC/sample limitation; no peer output was treated as a CRC oracle.
Verified ACadSharp #1297 reports an object-level MTEXT match but whole-AC1032 DWG rejection; omitted VisualStyle/section-view-style objects are an unproven hypothesis, and libdxfrw has no DWG writer.
Verified ACadSharp #1299 remains under-specified in its public issue text despite a linked archive; no artifact was downloaded and no spline diagnosis was transferred.
Confirmed the exact #1281 recursive-run and #1282 32,768-byte EED peer shapes map to existing local robustness and EED boundary owners; no duplicate tests or peer limits were added.
Updated both plan files with causal/status corrections and a bounded implementation-readiness sequence; no code, test, fixture, dependency, or support-claim change was made.
method.limitations: Peer reports and issue-maintainer measurements are version- and route-specific, not normative format rules or libdxfrw reproductions. The AC1021 tablet sample retains CRC warnings and is not a passing independent semantic witness. ACadSharp #1297's suspected document dependency is unproved; #1299's attached DWG/DXF archive was not inspected. This pass is research-only.

sources.observed: The issue's original point-array desynchronization diagnosis was withdrawn; the reported values came from reading RS codewords on uncompressed AC1021 data pages. PR #1363 merged to master on 2026-08-07 and reports a page-extent classifier plus comparison against ODA on named peer inputs.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer AC1021 implementation evidence only; not a CRC oracle or libdxfrw semantic result.

sources.observed: The reporter later verified restored entity counts at named LibreDWG master commit 56a05f98 and pointed to contemporaneous R2007 decode changes as the likely cause of the original three-file truncation symptom. PR #1359 separately proposes continuing after unresolved owned references with diagnostics and remains open in the reviewed page state.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Separates root-cause recovery from defensive iterator hardening; neither is a local defect or a support claim.

sources.observed: An AC1032 frame-only MTEXT with BackgroundFillFlags value 16 is reported rejected by AutoCAD 2025 while value 17 and AC1027 are accepted. The reporter says the MTEXT object payload can match AutoCAD byte-for-byte while the whole DWG remains rejected; absent VisualStyle and section/detail-view-style objects are only suspected causes.
sources.evidence_ceiling: ACadSharp DWG-writer and AutoCAD whole-file report; root cause unresolved and not applicable to a libdxfrw DWG writer.

sources.observed: The public report targets NuGet 3.8.0 and links a DWG/DXF archive, but does not publish offending SPLINE arrays, an entity handle, exact DXF version, GDAL diagnostic, or an independent expected curve.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Candidate SPLINE test shape only; artifact not fetched and no behavior transferred.

sources.observed: The issue bodies provide exact recursive-run examples for comments, XDATA application groups, and clip-boundary counts, plus a 32,768-byte signed-short DWG EED overflow example. Existing libdxfrw generated robustness and EED boundary controls already own these shapes.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer-specific failure thresholds and integer choices are not format limits and are not transferred.
